description.p: Glance opens an image, lets you make the everyday changes, and saves it, the way Preview does on a Mac. It is for quick jobs, not for painting or retouching.

ul.li: Adjust Size with pixels, percent or print units, resolution and a choice of resampling
Crop to a selection, freely or at a fixed ratio
Rotate and flip without losing quality until you save
Export to PNG, JPEG, WebP, TIFF, GIF or BMP, with quality and transparency options, and strip metadata
Mark up screenshots with rectangles, ovals, lines, arrows, highlights and text, editable until you move on
Read PDFs, and reorder, rotate, delete and insert pages, or merge PDFs by dropping them on the sidebar

screenshot.caption: A large photo fitted to the window, with the main menu (photo: Alex Moliski, Unsplash)

description.p: Security update: the bundled Pillow image library is updated from 12.1.1 to 13.0.0, which fixes known vulnerabilities in reading crafted image files. No other changes.
New app ID, io.github.kaibae19.Glance, in preparation for Flathub. No other changes. Settings from 1.0.0 are not carried over.
First release: viewing, Adjust Size, crop, rotate and flip, export, and markup.
